title: Add deterministic catalogs for SRD language and tool choices
description:
Combined vk23 audit follow-up.

The vk23 bundle is strong for class progression and structured choices, but some open-ended language/tool choices remain more prose-like than deterministic tooling would prefer.

Examples to inspect:
- Half-Elf / Human / High Elf language choices
- Acolyte language choices
- Bard musical instrument choices
- Monk artisan tool or musical instrument choices
- Other features/backgrounds that choose from "any language", "any tool", "musical instrument", or similar categories

This is not a source-coverage failure, but deterministic character creation needs stable choice domains and filters instead of bespoke prose interpretation.

Acceptance criteria:
- Add or expose canonical SRD choice domains for languages and tool categories where the SRD provides enough structure.
- Ensure relevant ancestry, background, and class feature choices reference those domains instead of relying only on prose.
- Preserve source text and source fidelity; do not invent options outside the SRD.
- Add tests for Half-Elf languages, Acolyte languages, Bard instrument choices, and Monk tool/instrument choices.
- Update choice coverage/audit output so these choices are visible as deterministic domains.
close_reason: Wired the already-existing standard-languages table and tool-category description grouping into languages[].from and toolProficiencyChoices[].from for Half-Elf/Human/High-Elf/Acolyte/Bard/Monk. Plumbed through rulesPackResolver/requiredChoices, replacing a duplicate hardcoded list. Regression tests for all named examples against the real pack
